title: Ka Jingrwai U Syiar Khasi (Ballad of the Sacred Solar Cock)
cultural_context: Sung during traditional ceremonies recounting how the rooster coaxed the sun goddess Ka Sngi to return from her cave, dispelling primeval darkness.

khasi: Khyllie ko syiar, kynmaw ia ka kular,
Kren ha ka lyndet pyrthei ba dum,
Kyrsiew ia ka Sngi ban wan phyrnai biang,
Ban pyniohi ia ka dur ka mariang.
english: Awaken, O cock, remember the primordial covenant,
Speak across the darkness of the shrouded world,
Awaken the Sun to shine forth again,
Revealing once more the countenance of nature.

vocabulary.syiar-kynmaw: the remembering cock / herald of cosmic dawn
vocabulary.lyndet-pyrthei: across the hidden depths of the world
